basics.name: Ayush Goel
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with expertise in distributed systems, identity platforms, and cloud infrastructure. Proven track record of delivering high-impact features, optimizing costs, and improving system reliability at scale.

work.name: Intuit
work.summary: Leading critical identity and authentication initiatives for Intuit's platform serving hundreds of millions of users.
highlights: Owned end-to-end design and delivery of mobile Driver's License (mDL) as account recovery authenticator across five states (CA, GA, CO, OH, IL)
Designed Redis caching strategy that reduced DynamoDB write traffic by ~75% in production and delivered ~$10K/month in infrastructure savings
Led cross-team delivery of Credit Karma sign-in initiatives contributing to $100M+ in downstream revenue impact
Set operational reliability strategy for Credential Service, migrating production traffic with zero customer impact
Championed AI-assisted development workflows, compressing multi-person sprint efforts into single sprint delivery
Served as primary on-call responder for high-severity incidents, leading deep root-cause analysis

work.name: Intuit
work.summary: Service owner for Tier-1 Credential Service supporting hundreds of millions of users via DynamoDB-backed REST and GraphQL APIs on AWS EKS.
highlights: Led large-scale Identity 2.0 migration of 620M identities, 2.5B credential records, and 21B user attributes with 100% on-time completion
Reduced infrastructure spend by $50K/month through cost-optimization strategies
Improved developer productivity by redesigning CI/CD pipelines and introducing improved autoscaling
Owned and delivered core APIs for Identity 1.0 → 2.0 transition

work.name: Intuit
work.summary: Designed and implemented CI/CD patterns for Identity 2.0 services.
highlights: Leveraged ArgoCD, Jenkins, Terraform, Kubernetes, and service mesh to improve deployment safety
Analyzed deployment metrics to identify velocity bottlenecks and drove Agile process improvements

work.name: Rochester Institute of Technology
work.summary: Developed research applications for cybersecurity analysis and prediction.
highlights: Developed ASSERT, a Java/Python application for synthesizing and analyzing cyberattack behavior models
Refactored research prototype into production-ready, containerized system
Built dynamic visualization dashboards using Python, Dash, and Plotly

work.name: Intuit
highlights: Migrated REST services from Spinnaker to Docker/Kubernetes with zero downtime
Built tooling to semi-automate migrations for other teams
